thread:
maria: spitball: implement a tiny market allocator for continuous batching. tenants emit ephemeral bids: (priority, value_per_token, est_tokens, latency_budget, affinity). scheduler runs a cheap match pass to assemble high-utility packs while honoring per-tenant SLO floors.
kevin: sounds neat. what's the tick rate? 5/10ms? OS jitter could add noise.
maria: plan is 10ms on a pinned batching core, single-threaded. fallback to safe allocator if match latency exceeds threshold.
nate: scoring idea: utility = value_per_token * est_tokens - alpha * max(0, est_latency - slo). alpha varies by tier. keep it simple first.
alice: affinity hints are key. without coalescing by prefix/cache-tag we might thrash the KV warm cache.
carol: agree. bids should carry affinity_tag (cold/warm:keyhash). matching should prefer same-affinity to reduce cache misses.
kevin: preemption constraints? can we evict queued groups when a high-value bid arrives? only waiting groups, never running ones.
maria: yes. preempt waiting groups only. also cap preemptions per-second to avoid thrash.
infra-bot: market-scheduler branch deployed to 2025-11-12T11:30:00Z
nate: fairness: add per-tenant min-allocation and bid-rate cap. adversarial tenants could spam micro-bids to monopolize.
alice: perf budget: matching loop must be <1ms p95. else disable and fallback. emit match_latency metric.
carol: telemetry: per-batch matched_utility, selected_affinities, match_time_ms, displaced_count, fairness_score. dashboards + sampling traces.
kevin: rollout: opt-in via header and pool gate. start internal then beta. safety toggles: 1) match-loop-time threshold 2) auto-roll back if p99 breaks 3) tenant opt-out.
maria: sim plan: synthetic mix (short latency-sensitive, long background, bursty high-value) to measure p50/p95/p99, gpu occupancy, token-cost. success: >=5% occupancy improvement without >5% p99 regressions for latency-sensitive tenants.
nate: include adversarial sim to validate fairness floor math. will add exponential backoff for repeat winners.
alice: impl sketch:
```
struct Bid { tenant_id, value_per_token, est_tokens, max_lat_ms, affinity_tag }
loop every 10ms {
  collect bids
  bucket by latency class
  greedy select to fill batch size maximizing utility + fairness_bonus
  if match_time > 2ms -> abort and fallback
  enqueue batches to gpu_queue
}
```
carol: consider a pack-merge step: if matched pack is too-small for efficient kernel, try to merge with low-priority background to hit kernel-friendly size.
kevin: ops alerts: fallback_rate >1% over 5m, displaced/sec spike, match_latency p95 >2ms.
maria: next steps: nate+alice prototype sim + match loop for 2 weeks; carol define telemetry; kevin wire canary flags; i'll draft RFC appendix with invariants.
kevin: +1. sync in 48h. :thumbsup:
